text:
A hot gas and a cool liquid are at the same pressure.
Which row describes the separation and the motion of the particles of a hot gas compared to
those of a cool liquid?
separation of gas particles
motion of gas particles
A
greater than a cool liquid
faster than a cool liquid
B
greater than a cool liquid
slower than a cool liquid
C
less than a cool liquid
faster than a cool liquid
D
less than a cool liquid
slower than a cool liquid

options.label: A
options.text: greater than a cool liquid faster than a cool liquid

options.label: B
options.text: greater than a cool liquid slower than a cool liquid

options.label: C
options.text: less than a cool liquid faster than a cool liquid

options.label: D
options.text: less than a cool liquid slower than a cool liquid
